sentences.zh: 乔尔，非常感谢你能来做客

sentences.en: So yeah, man, thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 所以，老兄，非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, I really appreciate connecting.
sentences.zh: 好的，我也非常高兴能有这次交流。

sentences.en: Connecting about Jung today?
sentences.zh: 今天是要聊聊荣格吗？

sentences.en: Yes, that's kind of what I'm hoping to get into.
sentences.zh: 对，这正是我希望能深入探讨的方向。

sentences.en: You know, I'm no Jungian analyst or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我并不是什么荣格学派分析师之类的人。

sentences.en: I'm just someone who's been really impacted by his writings.
sentences.zh: 我只是一个深受他的著作影响的人。

sentences.en: In my own psychotherapy, I worked with someone who was kind of an in-depth Jungian.
sentences.zh: 在我自己的心理治疗过程中，我曾和一位比较偏向深度荣格学派的人合作过。

sentences.en: And so I've been in that world for a little while, and I really appreciate many aspects of it.
sentences.zh: 所以我涉足那个世界已经有一段时间了，并且非常欣赏它的许多方面。

sentences.en: And I actually found out about you,
sentences.zh: 其实我注意到你，

sentences.en: I guess at some level, being connected to Jung.
sentences.zh: 我想在某种程度上也是因为你与荣格的联系。

sentences.en: You have this amazing episode with David Tacey that really spoke to me.
sentences.zh: 你和大卫·塔西的那期精彩节目真的深深触动了我。

sentences.en: And so yeah, I was just hoping to get into Jung and see how he's impacted you.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我只是希望能聊聊荣格，看看他是如何影响你的。

sentences.en: Yeah, Tacey, we were lucky to have that hour or two with him.
sentences.zh: 是的，塔西，我们很幸运能与他交流那一两个小时。

sentences.en: I do think he is definitely the only modern, but maybe one of the few recent people who kind of lets Jung breathe.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为他是绝对是现代人中，或者说可能是为数不多的近期能让荣格思想自由呼吸的人之一。

sentences.en: A lot of people put Jung into it because he's such a vast writer.
sentences.zh: 很多人把荣格框死，是因为他是一位著作极其丰富的作家。

sentences.en: He has all these ideas, and then people follow the implications of those ideas over the next 30 to 50 years.
sentences.zh: 他有各种各样的思想，然后人们在接下来的三到五十年里追随这些思想的延伸影响。

sentences.en: So most people, I think, concentrate on one portion of it.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为大多数人只专注于其中的一部分。

sentences.en: Or even worse, they try and make him only one element of something he wrote about it, not kind of the complexity of all of it.
sentences.zh: 或者更糟糕的是，他们试图把他写的东西简化为仅仅某一个单一元素，而不是去理解其整体的复杂性。

sentences.en: Because he did kind of what I think a lot of people do is he would get really obsessed with things that he didn't quite even know why.
sentences.zh: 因为他做过的事情——我想很多人也会这样做——就是会对某些事情极其着迷，甚至自己都不知道为什么。

sentences.en: But he felt like there was something that was in there that needed to be unlocked and understood that would fit back into a larger whole.
sentences.zh: 但他觉得里面有些东西需要被解开和理解，并最终融入一个更大的整体中。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of the conversations when he is feels like, well, alchemy is this
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当他探讨时，很多对话的感觉就像是，炼金术就是

sentences.en: projection of the human psyche onto pre-scientific minds or, you know, describing this change process of alchemy.
sentences.zh: 人类心灵在前科学思维上的投射，或者说，是在描述炼金术的这种转变过程。

sentences.en: You know, he loses one of his lovers and a couple of friends who are just like, I don't get it, man.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他失去了他的一位爱人和几个朋友，他们只是觉得：我不懂，老兄。

sentences.en: I don't want to talk about, you know, reducing down to the red powder and reclaiming the self.
sentences.zh: 我不想谈论什么还原成红色粉末并收复自我。

sentences.en: And, you know, later I think that fits into something, but I don't even think he knew what he was chewing on.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，后来我认为这契合了某些东西，但我甚至不认为他当时清楚自己在琢磨些什么。

sentences.en: So I think David really is one of the only writers that kind of lets him be.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为大卫确实是唯一几个能让他保持本色、不被过度解读的作家之一。

sentences.en: And maybe some of that is because he's not an analySt. He's not really in psychology.
sentences.zh: 也许部分原因是因为他不是分析师。他并不是真正从事心理学研究的。

sentences.en: And so he's kind of more of a scholar there, but I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以他在那里更像是一个学者，不过我也说不准。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 原来如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I like that.
sentences.zh: 对，没错，我挺喜欢这样的。

sentences.en: It kind of lets him breathe, you know, and it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这让他得以自由呼吸，你知道的，这很有趣。

sentences.en: I think you know quite a bit more about this than I do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你对这方面的了解比我多得多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为让塔西感到沮丧的是——尤其是塔西——他对为什么

sentences.zh: 我是说，有很多人，有很多荣格分析师，他们的行为就像是把荣格当成“心理治疗加耶稣”或是

sentences.zh: 我——我的意思是，我认为这些东西的美妙之处在于，荣格是一位从现象学角度为心灵绘制了绝佳地图的思想家。
